scopePolicy: P0-P10, J1-J7 and A01-A20 are mandatory delivery scope. Local implementation and bounded test receipts do not waive or pass full acceptance.

sourceOwnership.implementation: Existing public VibeEdit SDK foundation and VibeEdit-owned agent integration source; MIT governs owned code.
sourceOwnership.upstream: Optional public runtimes/models, fonts and dependencies keep their own terms. No private research library, source movie or model weights are intended for distribution.
sourceOwnership.commercialAuthority: Existing Myriograph account, API, payment and credit infrastructure; candidate native adapters do not constitute deployment proof.
sourceOwnership.operatorEvidence: Original private state, task ledger, source receipts and screenshots are retained separately and unchanged.

qualificationState.note: Existing platform capabilities and prior deployed surfaces remain evidence leads, not new launch acceptance.

policyAmendment.decision: Metered prepaid credit with optional explicitly consented auto top-up replaces recurring companion subscriptions and included monthly allowances.
policyAmendment.preserved: Managed inference, durable goals and all financial/recovery completion requirements remain mandatory.

Native source-bound face, word, beat and final-video review with durable corrections, human/model separation, stale-write protection and composition/render application.
Distributable optional TransNet, SAM 2.1, SAM 3.1 and Apple Silicon MLX model packs with pinned public sources/terms, cache/probes, real inference and cut/occlusion/contact review.
Pi companion controlled by existing Codex and Claude Code agents; BYOK and Myriograph-funded inference, profile selection, structured tools, streaming, steering and cancellation.
Durable multistep edit goals across parent disconnect and supervisor/Pi crashes; original operations, bounded reservations, stop/resume and verified completion artifacts.

Existing Myriograph signup/email/login, account/project/key selection, authorized sandbox funding, one-key three-service quotes/jobs/downloads and uncertainty.
Saved face/word/beat/render evidence, human corrections and unresolved identities survive restart/refresh/export and affect the next render.
Both parent harnesses run bounded Pi tasks through BYOK and Myriograph-managed inference with tools, artifact validation, steer and cancel.
Original goal continues or visibly waits across parent disconnect, supervisor/Pi crash and stop/resume without duplicate paid operations.
Reuse project/model cache; update skills without user-edit loss; source relink, correction render and scoped credential rotation/re-authentication.

acceptance.requiredPassingEvidence: Fresh Codex and fresh Claude Code runs using published artifacts; exact package versions/hashes, commands and doctor receipts. No prior VibeEdit installation or local checkout access.
Generated/user-owned media -> editable project -> mixed audio/video/text render -> review -> revision, with network/account access disabled after installing required local dependencies.
CFR/VFR, 23.976/29.97 rational clocks, audio/video offset, source relink, portrait/landscape and crop/mask alignment fixtures; frame/PTS assertions plus inspected render samples.
One new Myriograph customer key submits all three supported jobs, polls, downloads and verifies source/schema/digests; revoke/rotate and tenant/project scope tests pass.

Actual sandbox browser card entry, signed exact-endpoint webhook, single credit grant, three service reservations/debits, replay, cancellation/refund and final available/held balance reconciliation. Production configuration checked separately.
Delivered email/login, correct account selection, top-up, return-to-agent and expired/revoked-key reauthentication work. No internal key fallback or duplicate commercial account.

Merge/split/null identity, revised portrait, word addition/deletion/timing and human-vs-model refresh survive restart/export; stale revision conflicts; confirmed speaker links remain separate from proposals.
Arbitrary song load, waveform and M/drag/delete/undo, scrub/loop/color review; project save/reopen; exact beat adjustment reaches composition and render.
Fresh TransNet/SAM 2.1/SAM 3.1 setup and real outputs; Apple Silicon MLX case; cut/occlusion/contact masks reviewed; hashes/devices/provenance and unsupported-platform states accurate.
Each named parent harness completes a structured worker task through both funding paths; profile/model selection and streaming/cancellation verified; credentials remain private.

A real multistep edit goal spans multiple model turns and a parent disconnect; injected supervisor and Pi restarts preserve the same goal/jobs. Completion artifacts verified; repeated status polling is not counted as progress.

Concurrent child reservations, retail ceiling, insufficient balance, expired provider pricing, uncertain paid acknowledgement, stop/resume and completed replay preserve financial invariants and original handles.

Public unauthenticated source/archive access, npm/PyPI exact version install, Pi package install, stable setup URL, checksums/attestation, working Myriograph signup/docs/billing links and a fresh public-endpoint end-to-end run.
Metering/queue/error/credit/worker-health alerts delivered to a real configured destination; rate limits, support/incident/reconciliation and rollback procedures exercised.
